versioningPolicy: Every new update must increase the actual Android versionCode. The product left the RC stage at 2.6.0 (code 2600): stable releases drop the -rc.N suffix and tie their code band to major.minor, so 2.6.x uses 2600-2699 exactly as RC25 used 2500-2599, and a stable X.Y.Z always outranks X.Y.Z-rc.N. The package id never changes - it is the app's identity, and changing it would install a second app instead of updating the one people already have. CI verifies package, owner RSA encryption key and APK signer certificate against published Build 284.
